_press_variants: ⚑ THE TWO PRINTINGS ARE NOT THE SAME SETTING AND THEY DIFFER BY DROPPED LETTERS. Two sites found in this range where Gallica drops a letter the archive carries and BOTH copies are clean: 0324C tranferente (archive: transferente) and 0327D ministare (archive: ministrare). Our TEI follows Gallica in both. These are press variants with nobody to accuse: NO [sic:] was fired on either, the English renders the sense the sister printing carries, and both are logged in cruces-0010.md §2. A stint working this volume from Gallica alone will read both as Migne's defects and mark them. They are not.
